title: L¹ norm on a ball is controlled by pairings with smooth test functions bounded by 1 (duality)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and R, δ, C ∈ ℝ with δ > 0 (ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure), and let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable on B_{R+δ}(0). Assume ∫_{ℝⁿ} h(x)g(x) dx ≤ C for every smooth compactly supported g : ℝⁿ → ℝ with tsupport g ⊆ B_{R+δ}(0) and |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. Then ∫_{B_R(0)} |h(x)| dx ≤ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R δ C : ℝ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < δ → IntegrableOn h (ball 0 (R + δ)) → (∀ g : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball 0 (R + δ) → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → ∫ x, h x * g x ≤ C) → ∫ x in ball 0 R, |h x| ≤ C
